baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct 'knower of the unseen,' the repeated ghayb/ghaybihi, causative yuzhiru, and indefinite ahadan under negation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Clear apprehension remains with the knower while a causative transition from concealment into visibility or access is withheld from the entire recipient class.

activation_trace.role: The image of a thing becoming clear to its knower makes the opening noun the source-side possession of clarity.
The image of being hidden from sight or knowledge defines the domain whose two mentions bind object and possession.
Coming out into view supplies the outward transition that the causative verb places under divine control.
Exhaustive 'anyone' under negation closes the ordinary recipient class without leaving a numerical loophole.

changed_reading.before: God knows the unseen and does not tell anyone.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents a controlled boundary: divine clarity does not automatically become creaturely visibility or access.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ghayb, causative yuzhiru, and the preposition ala permit a depth-to-surface reading internal to the focus wording.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hidden is pictured as depth or buried structure, while disclosure is emergence onto an outer surface or acquisition of access over it; no one is independently raised into that vantage.

activation_trace.role: A low place in which something disappears gives the unseen a concealed depth rather than only an abstract unknownness.
Hidden roots beneath earth supply a structured interior whose effects may exist without the structure being exposed.
The upper or outer surface provides the opposite layer toward which disclosure would move concealed depth.
Finding out or gaining access turns surface emergence into an epistemic vantage over the hidden domain.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts known and unknown information.
changed_reading.after: It also maps a protected topology: concealed depth is not opened into a surface on which an observer may stand.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive 'His unseen' combines with ala, yuzhiru, and ahadan.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb can carry elevation or overcoming as well as visibility, so the negation denies installation of any creature in a position of mastery over the possessed hidden domain.

activation_trace.role: Clear apprehension locates epistemic competence at the divine source.
Concealment supplies the domain explicitly retained as 'His.'
Being over or overcoming makes disclosure potentially a grant of rank and control, which the negation refuses.
Exhaustive negation denies that jurisdiction to every possible creaturely claimant.

changed_reading.before: Disclosure would merely add information to a recipient.
changed_reading.after: Unrestricted disclosure would install a rival epistemic master, and the ayah denies that transfer of standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies a communication pipeline from concealed casting, through speech becoming outward, to acoustic reception; the focus ayah governs who may initiate that conversion from hidden knowledge into a hearable signal.

activation_trace.role: Hiddenness supplies the latent source state of the communication chain.
Coming into view supplies the controlled transition from latent content to an outwardly available form.
Casting knowledge secretly supplies a nonpublic transfer at the first stage of the relay.
Speech held within and not yet manifested supplies the latent verbal pole from which utterance can emerge.
Producing speech by articulation supplies the outward verbal pole of the same relay.
Auditory perception supplies the receiver endpoint at which disclosed content becomes creaturely evidence.

structural_cues: 72:1 orders command, revelation, listening, reported speech, and a second report of hearing.
The focus ayah places causative manifestation between possessed hiddenness and a potential recipient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secret casting, latent and articulated speech, and hearing; I infer a directed hidden-to-audible relay governed by the focus prohibition; alternatively these may be adjacent speech events rather than stages of one channel.

changed_reading.after: The ayah regulates conversion of concealed divine knowledge into utterance that another being can hear.

context_deltas.mechanism: Probing and listening encounter occupied guard positions and surveillance, turning the focus prohibition into an actively enforced perimeter around access to concealed information.

activation_trace.role: A hidden low place gives the protected material an interior location behind the perimeter.
Gaining access names the boundary-crossing action that the focus clause denies.
Seeking or feeling for something supplies active reconnaissance against the boundary.
Literal preservation and guarding supplies the defensive function of the occupied perimeter.
Auditory perception identifies the information-extraction operation attempted at the listening stations.
Sitting in wait for surveillance turns the stations into persistent access posts rather than incidental hearing.
Watchful guarding supplies interception at the attempted breach point.

structural_cues: 72:8-9 moves from touching the sky to finding it filled with guards, then from former listening seats to present interception.
The focus preposition ala supports a contested vantage over the hidden domain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reconnaissance, listening posts, guards, and watchers; I infer a security perimeter enforcing the focus rule; alternatively the defended sky may be a concrete episode without exhausting the general disclosure clause.

changed_reading.before: Non-disclosure is a passive absence of information.
changed_reading.after: Non-disclosure is active access control that detects, occupies, and intercepts unauthorized extraction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following exception does not erase the boundary: selection authorizes a messenger, insertion gives him a path, front and rear delimit it, and watchers escort it, producing a narrow guarded corridor through the prohibition.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive anyone establishes the default closure against which the following exception has force.
Gaining access supplies what is exceptionally granted in bounded form.
Acceptance rather than displeasure supplies the authorization decision that selects the exception.
Messenger and message supply a role-defined carrier rather than an unrestricted knower.
Inserting one thing into another supplies the controlled placement of protection around the carrier's route.
The interval between two sides supplies the corridor's bounded middle.
The idiom of what lies before the hands supplies the guarded forward side of transmission.
What lies behind supplies the guarded rear side, closing the route in both directions.
Watchful guarding supplies continuous escort and containment along the authorized path.

structural_cues: Illa immediately reverses the default closure for one selected class.
The paired 'before him' and 'behind him' spatially encloses the messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selection, a messenger, insertion, two-sided enclosure, and watching; I infer a narrow authorized transport corridor rather than wholesale opening of the unseen; alternatively the watchers may protect only the messenger, not delimit information scope.

changed_reading.after: The default is universal closure, but a selected messenger may traverse a tightly bounded and guarded disclosure corridor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker disclaims possession, is limited to delivery, bears messages as a messenger, and is selected rather than self-authorized; disclosure therefore delegates performance without transferring title to the unseen.

activation_trace.role: The possessive hidden domain remains attached to its source even when some content is carried outward.
Being over or dominant frames unrestricted disclosure as a standing that is not ceded.
Ownership and power of disposal supply the expressly disclaimed form of independent agency.
Delivering a message supplies a bounded duty of conveyance rather than proprietary control of its source.
Messenger and message define the agent by commission and carried content.
Acceptance supplies source-side choice rather than recipient-side seizure of authority.

structural_cues: 72:21 denies ownership, 72:23 restricts the task with illa to conveyance, and 72:27 restricts the recipient by selection.
The focus ayah retains the possessive 'His unseen.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied ownership, a delivery duty, messenger status, and selection; I infer that access transfers neither title nor independent disposal; alternatively the ownership denial may concern harm and guidance only, with the agency distinction supplied more narrowly by messenger grammar.

changed_reading.before: An excepted messenger becomes a secondary possessor of unseen knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The messenger receives custody for delivery while the unseen remains nontransferably God's in ownership and authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creaturely cognition moves through conjecture, eventual sight and retrospective knowledge, while still confessing ignorance about temporal nearness and endpoint; the focus opening marks divine knowledge as direct possession of what remains hidden along that creaturely sequence.

activation_trace.role: Doubt and supposition supply the provisional starting state of creaturely judgment.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the later evidentiary event that ends mere anticipation.
A thing becoming clear to the knower supplies knowledge reached after the promised event is seen.
Knowing or finding out is explicitly negated, marking the creature's present epistemic limit.
Temporal nearness supplies one unknown alternative concerning when the promise arrives.
An endpoint or limit supplies the other unknown temporal horizon set by the Lord.
Direct clarity at the focus opening contrasts with the context's delayed and admitted creaturely knowing.
The branch image of uncertainty sharpens what remains doubtful for creatures but not for the divine knower.

structural_cues: 72:24 makes seeing precede future knowing; 72:25 immediately restores present 'I do not know'; 72:26 answers with 'knower of the unseen.'
Earlier repeated conjectures provide the long-form contrast between supposition and disclosed certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conjecture, sight-then-knowledge, confessed temporal ignorance, and the divine knower; I infer two different epistemic pathways, direct possession versus evidence-bound discovery; alternatively the sequence may contrast only scopes of knowledge, not modes of knowing.

changed_reading.before: The unseen is merely a body of facts withheld from creatures.
changed_reading.after: The ayah distinguishes direct divine apprehension from creaturely cognition that must conjecture, wait, see, and only then know.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing purpose clause joins successful delivery to complete encompassing and itemized counting, so selective disclosure operates as a closed, accounted transmission rather than an uncontrolled leak from hiddenness.

activation_trace.role: Clear apprehension supplies the source knowledge that governs the transmission.
Precaution through backup supplies a focus-internal security shade for controlled manifestation.
Becoming clear to a knower supplies the stated purpose tied to completed delivery.
Delivery of the message supplies the event whose completion is made manifest and accountable.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and custody closes the transmission around all involved material.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies item-level accounting rather than approximate oversight.
Counting the countable supplies the explicit metric of total coverage.

structural_cues: 72:28 links li-yalama, qad ablaghu, encompassing, exhaustive counting, and number in one closure.
This accounting follows immediately after the selected messenger and two-sided guard.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, a purpose of knowing, encompassing, and exhaustive count; I infer a feedback-like verification that closes the authorized channel; alternatively li-yalama may mark manifestation of already complete knowledge rather than acquisition or operational feedback.

changed_reading.before: Disclosure is a one-way release from knower to messenger.
changed_reading.after: Authorized disclosure is an enclosed and fully accounted delivery whose completion remains under source-side knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Crowds can pile into a mass and supporters can be compared by number, but repeated exhaustive no-one formulas distribute the focus exclusion across every member; aggregation never becomes a collective route into the unseen.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive anyone under negation supplies closure over both one and more than one.
Individuals distributed one by one supplies the mechanism by which a crowd remains covered memberwise.
A dense mass piled layer upon layer supplies the strongest image of collective aggregation in the context.
The repeated exhaustive no-one formula confirms that no protector is omitted from the negative class.
Aid that makes one prevail or appear supplies the imagined collective backing that still cannot breach the rule.
Smallness supplies the comparative scale on which supporters are judged.
Enumeration supplies explicit collective number, which the focus exclusion renders irrelevant to access.

structural_cues: 72:19 pictures a crowd piled around the servant; 72:22 denies any protector; 72:24 compares supporter and number.
Ahadan recurs throughout the surah in negative constructions before returning in the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies piled crowds, exhaustive negatives, support, and count; I infer that numerical aggregation cannot bypass a memberwise exclusion; alternatively the crowd may describe reaction rather than an attempted epistemic breach.

changed_reading.before: Ahadan excludes a single individual recipient.
changed_reading.after: The exhaustive singular also defeats collective scaling: no crowd, alliance, or counted body acquires access by accumulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context closes routes of evasion, flight, protective adjacency, and lateral refuge; the focus denial of being placed 'over' the unseen therefore sits within a jurisdiction that cannot be escaped or approached from a protected side channel.

activation_trace.role: A concealed low place supplies the tempting image of a hidden route or refuge.
Being over or overcoming supplies the superior position that no evasive route can obtain.
Outrunning and escaping pursuit supplies the bypass explicitly judged impossible.
Frightened flight supplies the spatial strategy that cannot leave divine reach.
Protective adjacency under another's guarantee supplies the unavailable external jurisdiction.
Leaning sideways into a refuge supplies the unavailable side route around the boundary.

structural_cues: 72:12 negates escape both on earth and by flight; 72:22 negates protector and refuge apart from God.
The focus uses ala for a superior position over a domain still marked as 'His.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed escape, flight, protective adjacency, and lateral refuge; I infer that the disclosure boundary has no external jurisdiction or side entrance; alternatively these clauses may concern punishment and protection without directly describing information access.

changed_reading.before: A creature lacks permission but might conceivably find another route to hidden knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The possessed unseen lies within an unbypassable jurisdiction: neither superior force, flight, protector, nor side refuge yields access.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material water and buried-root side branches rather than the ordinary epistemic senses; it remains anchored in both focus occurrences of ghayb, the alim inventory, and causative emergence, while 72:16-17 supplies abundant water as a test; downstream prose should label it a material analogy for controlled release, not a lexical replacement or settled interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Alim's gathered-water branch, ghayb as hidden depth and buried roots, and yuzhiru as emergence permit a reservoir image within the focus inventory.

activation_trace.role: A large gathered body of water supplies the reservoir side of the material analogy.
A low place that hides its contents supplies the reservoir's concealed basin.
Buried roots that appear only through excavation supply hidden distribution below the visible surface.
Emergence into view supplies release from the concealed basin.
Giving drink supplies the directed beneficial outlet of the released resource.
Water appearing, entering, and becoming abundant supplies the material's movement into availability.
Abundant water and provision supplies the scale of the controlled release.
Testing metal or person supplies the reason abundance may be released selectively rather than simply exposed.

changed_reading.before: The unseen is an abstract store of information kept secret.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it behaves like a buried reservoir whose measured release can irrigate and test without exposing the whole source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes yusliku through its sewing-thread branch and reads disclosure as a narrow strand; it remains anchored in the focus transition from hiddenness to emergence and in the immediately following insertion, interval, and guard language; downstream prose should present it only as a spatial-material visualization of bounded transmission, not as the verb's required literal sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yuzhiru over ghayb supplies emergence across a concealed field, while the next ayah supplies an inserted and watched path.

activation_trace.role: A dense thicket in which one disappears supplies a concealed field through which only a narrow route is legible.
Coming into view supplies the strand's emergence without making the whole concealed field visible.
A thread used for sewing supplies the exploratory image of a message drawn as a narrow strand through concealment.
The middle interval between two sides supplies the strand's bounded passage.
Watchful guarding supplies protection along the narrow path rather than exposure of the surrounding hidden field.

changed_reading.before: Disclosure opens a broad window onto the unseen.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, disclosure threads one guarded strand through concealment while leaving the surrounding hidden field closed.

strongest_changes: The focus prohibition became an access-control boundary enforced against probing and listening rather than a passive lack of disclosure.
The exception became a selected, two-sided guarded corridor that delegates carriage without transferring ownership of the unseen.
The closing accounting language turned revelation into an enclosed and verified delivery rather than an uncontrolled one-way release.
The contrast between conjecture, sight, delayed knowledge, and confessed ignorance sharpened divine knowledge as a different epistemic mode.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled ghayb and the breadth of yuzhiru supported simultaneous informational, spatial, jurisdictional, and transmission models; the surrounding surah then supplied unusually explicit probes, guards, messenger selection, route enclosure, delivery, and exhaustive accounting.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ala with yuzhiru should foreground access, dominance, disclosure, or merely the normal construction remains open across the retained models.
The security architecture may generalize the concrete sky-listening episode more strongly than the syntax alone requires.
The purpose 'so that He may know' can mark manifest verification without implying any acquisition of previously absent divine knowledge.
The reservoir and threaded-path readings are deliberately contained material analogies and should not be promoted to lexical conclusions.
